title: the inference proxy stands at its outline address in both roots
intention: The inference proxy device stands at cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/, the address outline 11.4 names, in class-space and instance-space alike, answering the bus and command line as inference (11.4.2), with its folder, tree and logs named inferenceproxy.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: ls cairn/devices shows inference_domain/, while outline 11.4 reads 'INFERENCE PROXY DEVICE (cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/)' (question open-fc9a70eb49cf). The old name is also the device's live identity in six places: bus id, tree OWNER, the pg table inference_domain_answers_nodes, METRIC_SOURCE, ~/.cairn/logs/inference_domain/0/ and instance_path for the route overlay.
traces_to: Law 5 (the thing and its story may live in two roots, never contradicting); CLAUDE.md: devices/<device>/<instance>/ is one address written in two roots; outline 11.4.
how: Scope A, no alias (orchestrator 2026-11-13); bus and CLI name 'inference' per outline 11.4.2 (open-3228703f7fb3). HELD: build only after the orchestrator sends 'release inferenceproxy', once batch11 on Linux has crossed d97eae68962c and resealed the proxy proof inside the old folder. Then the rename and each box's recipe run happen in one act on Linux. Code moves by D1 and D2, live spec by D3; the recipe D4 moves instance-space per box; D5 proves it.

out: ~/.cairn on any box, except through the recipe its holder runs

outcomes.claim: git grep over cairn finds no live code naming inference_domain outside the recipe's old-name constants and the device's append-only history.json; the device answers the bus and the command line as inference (outline 11.4.2)
outcomes.via: git mv cairn/devices/inference_domain cairn/devices/inferenceproxy. Inside it, the bus id and the CLI name become 'inference' (outline 11.4.2, 11.4.9; open-3228703f7fb3), and the identity strings addressed in a root become inferenceproxy: OWNER and ANSWERS (inferenceproxy_answers_nodes, domain.py), METRIC_SOURCE for new rows, log_path/instance_path, route's OVERLAY_PATH, host.py's slots path. history.json is append-only and stays as written. every other referent in cairn (cairn/, skills/, bin/) moves in the same act: dotted imports cairn.devices.inference_domain, slash paths, path-joined segments ("inference_domain" beside devices), and the bus address to="inference_domain" (librarian, aider_shim, codemother, cairn, tester and the rest the census names). The regex matches at a (?<![\w./]) segment boundary and never rewrites a ~/.cairn path. Validations are resealed, never hand-edited. in CairnCommons only live spec moves: intentions-not-beside-code/ files naming the old path, and the watchme.probe paths on non-terminal tickets. Tickets, slates, rehearsals, berths, certificates, decisions and the journal stay as written (historical records). The lab regenerates through recompile_gate.sh. cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/rename_instance.py runs as apply|verify over the running box's HOME. apply is idempotent: it moves ~/.cairn/devices/inference_domain and ~/.cairn/logs/inference_domain to inferenceproxy, merging when both stand; on the box that holds the answers table it runs ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS inference_domain_answers_nodes RENAME TO inferenceproxy_answers_nodes and rewrites the tree's owner rows through the store primitives. Metric rows stay under inference_domain. verify reds while any old-name instance dir or table stands. The holder runs it on each box in the same act as the device restart (the home box by the orchestrator on Linux). cairn/devices/inferenceproxy/proofs/test_the_proxy_stands_at_its_outline_address.py, one tooth per clause. It greps cairn for live old-name code; runs apply twice and verify over a scratch HOME; runs the table and owner step over a fixture connection and asserts that metric rows are untouched.
